mode: kinematic multi-GNSS ionosphere-free phase PPP, WUM MGEX products

probe_tight_biased.note: sigma 0.02 m + 5 m bias -- verifies the constraint reaches position

finding: In clean 24 h multi-GNSS phase PPP the receiver clock is observation-limited to ~1 cm, so a realistic-quality network clock prior (sigma ~0.5-1 m) is a no-op. The prior's operational niche is real-time / single-frequency / few-satellite / degraded-geometry PPP, not standard post-processed PPP.
